_note: Community-maintained reputation leaderboard for the Fluent ecosystem. This file drives the Leaderboard tab on BlendDash. To add or update a project, submit a PR to https://github.com/Pelz01/blenddash — see README below for field docs.

fields.project: Display name of the project or entity.
fields.repScore: Reputation score (integer, 0–10000). Based on on-chain Prints activity, developer engagement, and community trust signals.
fields.category: One of: DeFi, Infra, Tooling, Bridge, Identity, Governance, Analytics, Explorer, Wallet, Social, or AI.
fields.change7d: 7-day score change (integer, positive = gain, negative = loss).
fields.description: Short description of what the project does.
fields.verified: Set to true if the project is confirmed as part of the Fluent ecosystem by the BlendDash maintainers. Community submissions start as false.

_readme.contributing: 1. Fork https://github.com/Pelz01/blenddash. 2. Edit src/data/reputation.json — add or update entries. 3. Keep repScore reasonable (0–10000) and change7d modest (±500). 4. Submit a PR with a description of your changes.
_readme.disclaimer: Reputation scores are community-estimated and do not reflect official Fluent Labs rankings. For on-chain reputation, use Fluent Prints at https://portal.fluent.xyz/user.

entries.description: Core smart contract framework for building on Fluent L2. Compiles to rWasm and supports Rust and Solidity. The foundation all Fluent dApps build on.
ZK-friendly Rust-based WebAssembly virtual machine that powers Fluent's blended execution environment. Safe, high-performance, blockchain-compatible.
Official Fluent block explorer. Real-time transaction tracing, contract verification, and token holdings view. Featured on fluent.xyz ecosystem page.
On-chain reputation primitives on Fluent. Create Prints to build portable trust scores. The backbone of Fluent's identity and reputation layer.
Fast cross-chain bridge powered by Hyperlane. Connects Fluent to Ethereum and other L2s with low latency. Featured on fluent.xyz ecosystem page.
Official Fluent CLI for project scaffolding, local testnets, contract compilation, and deployment. Supports Rust and Solidity workflows.
Fluent's native L1↔L2 bridge. Slower than Nexus but more secure — ideal for large transfers and institutional flows.
Ethereum Virtual Machine (EVM) written in Rust for Fluent's rWasm environment. Enables Solidity contract execution within blended apps.
Integrated developer toolbox on the Fluent portal. Contract deployment, testing utilities, and gas faucet access in one place.
Official Hardhat plugin that compiles Rust contracts to WebAssembly (Wasm) and generates Hardhat artifacts for Fluent development.
